items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Charles Horvath gave that to him.

ctx.x: That's the gong from the Goldkette band. Charles Horvath gave that to him.

It's the morning, the next morning, February 13th. Chauncey and Virginia are asleep. I have his book of letters, clippings, photographs, they very kindly let me look through. I thought before they wake up, I might read some of these clippings that perhaps the Institute would be interested in. There is an article here from the Sunday
